# Data-quality notes (auto-generated by scripts/01_eda.py)

* Partitions analysed: train (80 trips), student_test (10 trips). Evaluator-testing data was not used.
* Rows with missing/non-numeric values: 0.
* Non-increasing timestamps: 0.
* Mean fraction of 1-second steps: 0.943; gaps >5 s: 1260; gaps >30 s: 135; largest gap 153064 s.
* Trips spread over several countries/continents (lon -100.4..137.2, lat -34.6..61.7) -> per-trip local projection.
* Every trip has its own road-network files; arc ids are trip-local.
* Reference routes are connected arc chains (mean consecutive-connected fraction 0.999).
* Two-way roads are stored as two opposite directed arcs (median two-way fraction 0.95): the nearest segment alone cannot tell the direction -> heading features.
* GPS->reference distance on clean training trips: p50=5.0 m, p90=13.6 m, p99=70.0 m, p99.9=517.2 m.
* Trips whose reference route does not follow the GPS (median distance > 30 m): 00000033 (train, 122 m), 00000054 (train, 140 m)
  These labels are unreliable; such TRAIN trips are excluded from model fitting (student-test trips are kept and reported as-is).
